title: decode_ffmpeg
description: Decodes compressed video with FFmpeg, optionally on the GPU, and forwards raw frames in the chosen pixel format.

threads.description: FFmpeg decoder thread count; 0 lets FFmpeg choose.

stream_filter.description: Stream ids to decode; empty decodes every stream.

output_format.description: Output pixel format; unknown values fall back to yuv420p.

codec.description: FFmpeg decoder name that overrides the codec detected from StreamMetadata.

hw_decode.description: Parsed but unused; hardware decode is controlled by hwaccel.

hwaccel.description: Hardware decode device; frames are downloaded to CPU unless gpu_output is set, and unknown values mean none.

gpu_output.description: Emit CUDA or VideoToolbox frames as GPU descriptors valid only during the on_frame call.
